# Practice Butterfly Comb Trainer in Black Metal

Build your butterfly comb skills with this one-piece black metal practice trainer. It suits first-time learners and experienced flippers who want a safe, hands-on tool for refining their moves.

## Key Features

- 440C stainless steel construction
- Foldable design with a metal handle
- About 130g, measuring roughly 8.66" x 1.22"
- No sharp edges and no sharpened blade
- Balanced weight with a centered center of mass

## Benefits for Your Practice

The balanced weight and centered center of mass help the trainer flip smoothly, so you can focus on technique instead of fighting the tool. The solid metal handle gives a secure grip, and the blade-free design makes it a good choice for teaching safe handling to younger learners.

## Made for Safe, Everyday Practice

Each trainer is brand new and built for durability. With no sharp edges, it works for practice at home or in a classroom. Shoppers give it 4.1 out of 5 across more than 1,400 ratings.
